headline: Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: Engineer who has worked on both sides of a deployment: five years inside a hospital system turning clinics' needs into Epic changes and training 600+ staff to use them, then four at JPMorgan Chase building customer-facing software. Builds AI applications for regulated work end to end, from workflow to audit trail.

text.cycle: Worked with specialty and radiology clinics to cut referral cycle time from order to scheduled appointment, gathering their requirements and coordinating Epic Referrals and Cadence enhancements with analysts.

projects.name: Caduceus
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, React, FHIR, SMART on FHIR, OIDC, Cloud Run
bullets: Prior-authorization agent built as a deployment for a simulated health system: reads the referral, checks the record against insurer policy, asks the clinician only for what's missing and drafts the request a specialist approves.

Fits the customer's systems: launches from the EHR (SMART on FHIR), signs in through the clinic's identity provider and keeps patient data inside the clinic; of 181 planted identifiers, none reached the outside model.

projects.name: Lattice
projects.stack: Rust, React, TypeScript, ROS 2, Gazebo, MuJoCo
bullets: Robot-fleet control plane that keeps a mission's objective when the route or the body changes: a Rust core plans, holds detours and handoffs for operator approval and signs commands; an agent on each robot verifies them.
A guided public tour replays three recorded runs: no completed inspection repeated after a detour or handoff.

projects.name: 0VERTRAINED
bullets: Training app for athletes who lift and race, taken alone from idea to beta: per-metric arbitration between Oura and Whoop, a daily readiness verdict and a server-routed LLM coach.
In beta on version 19.6; 2,030 automated tests, row-level security on every table, encrypted wearable tokens.
